findings.passage: The voter challenges happening in Bryan County today are a direct result of Senate Bill 202 and Senate Bill 189, which were pushed by the Republican Legislature and Governor Brian P. Kemp.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name after a Bryan County hearing on voter challenges. He ties the challenges to SB 202 and SB 189 and says he spoke against SB 189.

findings.passage: I urge my colleagues to repeal these harmful laws.
findings.note: In the same statement he calls for repeal of SB 202 and SB 189, which he describes as letting almost anyone challenge a neighbor's registration and eligibility.
